tool.observe: Observe nearby Pals and resources; poll until ready.
tool.path: Read a walking route to a target within 500 metres.
tool.ui: Read native screens and current element IDs.
tool.move: Move relative to the camera for up to two seconds.
tool.stop: Stop movement, camera automation and held inputs.
tool.install_mod: Install a bundled mod without restarting.
tool.remove_mod: Remove a mod and its active objects.
tool.enable_mod: Enable or disable an installed mod.
tool.configure_mod: Update settings. Autonomy starts only when running is explicitly true.
tool.diagnostics: Read runtime diagnostics and CPU timings.
tool.set_language: Set and remember the language; auto follows the game.
